highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates the renderer and broadens support for current .NET, desktop, and Tizen environments.
highlights_body: It refreshes the bundled Skia engine, restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments, and updates native support across GTK4, WebAssembly, and Tizen.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with the current upstream Skia milestone and integrates the preceding m155 fork cleanup.
NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again locate installed system fonts.
Updates .NET 11 preview pins and the corresponding WebAssembly native assets for current runtime compatibility.
Adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel-scaling support for GTK desktop applications.
Moves Tizen native builds and packaging to the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments
